create.title: New agent
create.banner: 🔒 After creation the machine, client, model, access, folders and instructions cannot change. To change them, delete the agent and create a new one.
create.handleArchived: An archived agent had this name; you can take it over. Its old messages stay with the old agent.
create.apiKeyBody: Gets only a token (shown once); connects from its own client and gets no folders.

modeHint.direct: direct: one continued session per thread, runs from the root folder.
modeHint.compact: compact: a short decision round, the work in a separate run.

create.riskyMode: ⚠ Bypasses every permission: only if you know what you are doing.
create.sandboxBody: Sees only the granted folders, runs no commands (bwrap).
create.fullAccessBody: Runs from its root folder with your own settings, CLAUDE.md and MCP servers; runs commands too.
create.worktreeHint: A git repo; the agent works on its own branch.
create.grantsHint: These are what it sees in the sandbox.
create.grantsFullHint: Extra folders beyond the root for full access.
create.approvalsHint: chat: asks in the chat before risky steps (Claude Code).
create.previewHint: May start a web preview on the machine; full access only.
create.webReadHint: May read public web pages through the guard; sandbox only.
create.apiKeyNoAccess: An API-key agent has no machine or folders.
create.guardOnly: Set on the machine (guard.yaml), read-only here: sandbox: {{sandbox}} · unsandboxed agents allowed: {{unsandboxed}}.
create.secretWarning: The instructions go into the agent's prompt: never put a secret (token, password, key) in them.
create.sessionHint: A new session starts after this many context tokens.
create.channelsHint: Later changed in the channel settings.
create.ack: I understand these cannot change later; to change them I have to delete the agent and create a new one.
create.tokenBody: Shown only now: copy it into its client. A secret: never paste it into the chat.

settings.title: Agent settings
settings.displayNameHint: The display name cannot change yet.
settings.noLimits: An API-key agent has no machine limits.
settings.fixedInfo: Fixed at creation. To change it, make a copy as a new agent, then delete this one.
settings.archivedConfig: An archived agent: its machine configuration ended.
settings.stopBody: Its running work stops and its tokens stop working. An admin can start it again.

deleteList.runs: Its runs stop and its terminals are killed.
deleteList.terminals: Its machine drops it on the next config fetch.
deleteList.access: Its tokens, folder grants and channel memberships end.
deleteList.handle: The handle becomes free for a new agent.

settings.archivedNotice: This agent is archived: everything is read-only, but you can make a copy of it.
